title: Making Luck ep. 24 (ep. 23 kingdom): Trade Route, Archive, Den of Sin, Market Square, Gladiator, Colony

sources.author: Adam Horton and Jake
sources.note: Making Luck ep. 24, review of the previous episode's kingdom after playing it, about 3:18-17:12 (audio timestamps)

quality_note: Two top players played several games and agree on the Trade Route/Archive/Den of Sin core, but split on the opening and on how a Haggler/Archive money deck compares.

kingdom.setup_notes: Gladiator is a split pile with Fortune underneath. Fool's Heirloom: each player starts with a Lucky Coin in place of one Copper. Boons are used (Fool). Trade Route: a token on each Victory Supply pile moves to the Trade Route mat when the first card is gained from it.

edition: First-edition Trade Route and Horse Traders. Kingdom list from the episode description (Platinum and Colony).
